findings.message: Default session middleware settings: `domain` not set. It indicates the domain of the cookie; use it to compare against the domain of the server in which the URL is being requested. If they match, then check the path attribute next.
findings.disposition: Intentional host-only cookie: no Domain attribute broadening scope. Domain ownership is a deployment boundary.

findings.message: Default session middleware settings: `expires` not set. Use it to set expiration date for persistent cookies.
findings.disposition: maxAge=3600000 calculates Expires; the library recommends maxAge instead of explicitly setting expires.

findings.message: Default session middleware settings: `path` not set. It indicates the path of the cookie; use it to compare against the request path. If this and domain match, then send the cookie in the request.
findings.disposition: express-session defaults cookie.path to /, matching all app routes.

findings.message: Default session middleware settings: `secure` not set. It ensures the browser only sends the cookie over HTTPS.
findings.disposition: cookie.secure is options.production; live startup forces production and HTTPS origin. Offline demo uses HTTP on loopback. Proxy/TLS deployment remains untested.

njsscan.limitation: Executed on Windows, although the documented supported platforms are Linux/macOS. No claim of complete semantic coverage; supported-platform CI is configured but has not run.

assurance: Pattern scanning and dependency advisories are not a penetration test or proof of security.
